title: Tibetan medicine Siwei Zhixie Mutang powder ameliorates ulcerative colitis by suppressing JAK2/STAT3 and NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: Yue, Guang; Xu, Chenlei; Liu, Huina; Zhu, Zichen; Chen, Yuan; Jiang, Ge; Liu, Xiaoya; Dou, Jie; Mo, Ge; Ren, Qingjia; Wan, Jianbo; Li, Caolong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究藏药复方对溃疡性结肠炎的作用机制，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白（TNFR1）互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Siwei Zhixie Mutang Powder (SZMP) is a traditional Tibetan herbal formula widely used for gastrointestinal disorders, including enteritis, colitis, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and dysentery. Since ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic inflammatory disorder of the colon within the broader spectrum of intestinal inflammatory diseases, the traditional use of SZMP provides an ethnopharmacological basis for investigating its effects in experimental colitis. However, its key bioactive constituents and underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly defined. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to identify the principal active compounds, potential targets, and molecular mechanisms by which SZMP exerts protective effects against DSS-induced ulcerative colitis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: An integrative strategy combining UPLC-MS/MS analysis, network pharmacology, transcriptomics, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation (MD), microscale thermophoresis (MST), and in vivo experimental validation was established. A DSS-induced ulcerative colitis mouse model was used to evaluate disease activity, histopathological injury, inflammatory responses, apoptosis-related changes, and the activation status of the JAK2/STAT3 and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. RESULTS: UPLC-MS/MS identified 40 major constituents in SZMP, and 132 potential bioactive compounds with 913 predicted targets were retained after SwissADME screening. Integrated network pharmacology and transcriptomics revealed that SZMP mainly regulated inflammation- and apoptosis-related processes, particularly the JAK-STAT and NF-kappaB pathways. In DSS-induced colitis mice, SZMP alleviated disease symptoms, colonic injury, inflammatory cytokine overproduction, and excessive apoptosis, while inhibiting JAK2/STAT3 and NF-kappaB activation. UPLC-MS/MS quantification showed low levels of aristolochic acid A and strychnine in SZMP, and no obvious toxicity-related signs or major organ abnormalities were observed after 7 days of administration. Docking, MD simulation, and MST further supported a stable and direct interaction between (+)-catechin and TNFR1. CONCLUSION: SZMP protected against DSS-induced ulcerative colitis, possibly through multi-constituent regulation of inflammation- and apoptosis-related targets, mainly involving the JAK2/STAT3 and NF-kappaB pathways. MD simulation and MST further showed that (+)-catechin directly bound to TNFR1, suggesting its potential role in modulating the TNF/TNFR1-NF-kappaB inflammatory axis. In addition, UPLC-MS/MS quantification and 7-day safety evaluation indicated low exposure levels of aristolochic acid A and strychnine, with no obvious toxicity-related signs or major organ abnormalities observed under the experimental conditions. These findings provide experimental evidence for the pharmacodynamic basis, mechanism, and short-term safety profile of SZMP in UC intervention.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：四味止泻木汤散（SZMP）是一种传统藏药复方，广泛用于胃肠道疾病，包括肠炎、结肠炎、腹痛、腹泻和痢疾。由于溃疡性结肠炎（UC）是肠道炎症性疾病谱系中的一种慢性结肠炎症性疾病，SZMP的传统应用为其在实验性结肠炎中的效应研究提供了民族药理学基础。然而，其关键生物活性成分和潜在分子机制仍不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在鉴定SZMP对DSS诱导的溃疡性结肠炎发挥保护作用的主要活性化合物、潜在靶点和分子机制。材料与方法：建立了一种整合策略，结合UPLC-MS/MS分析、网络药理学、转录组学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟（MD）、微量热泳动（MST）和体内实验验证。使用DSS诱导的溃疡性结肠炎小鼠模型评估疾病活动度、组织病理学损伤、炎症反应、凋亡相关变化以及JAK2/STAT3和NF-kappaB信号通路的激活状态。结果：UPLC-MS/MS鉴定出SZMP中40种主要成分，经SwissADME筛选后保留132种潜在生物活性化合物和913个预测靶点。整合网络药理学和转录组学揭示，SZMP主要调节炎症和凋亡相关过程，特别是JAK-STAT和NF-kappaB通路。在DSS诱导的结肠炎小鼠中，SZMP缓解了疾病症状、结肠损伤、炎症细胞因子过度产生和过度凋亡，同时抑制JAK2/STAT3和NF-kappaB激活。UPLC-MS/MS定量显示SZMP中马兜铃酸A和士的宁含量较低，给药7天后未观察到明显毒性相关体征或主要器官异常。对接、MD模拟和MST进一步支持(+)-儿茶素与TNFR1之间的稳定直接相互作用。结论：SZMP对DSS诱导的溃疡性结肠炎具有保护作用，可能通过多成分调节炎症和凋亡相关靶点实现，主要涉及JAK2/STAT3和NF-kappaB通路。MD模拟和MST进一步表明(+)-儿茶素直接结合TNFR1，提示其在调节TNF/TNFR1-NF-kappaB炎症轴中的潜在作用。此外，UPLC-MS/MS定量和7天安全性评估显示马兜铃酸A和士的宁暴露水平较低，在实验条件下未观察到明显毒性相关体征或主要器官异常。这些发现为SZMP在UC干预中的药效基础、机制和短期安全性特征提供了实验证据。
